name: Tarique Rahman
role: Chairman of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party
contribution: He led the BNP into the 2026 parliamentary election and became the party's central campaign figure after returning from exile.
context: Bangladesh's 2026 national election, BNP campaign and post-election government formation.
impact: His victory made him the main face of the BNP-led government that emerged from the 2026 vote.
highlight: The BNP's chief campaign figure and eventual parliamentary leader.
